fields.name: Phewa Lake & Tal Barahi
fields.description: Phewa Lake is the crown jewel of Pokhara tourism. Wooden painted rowboats ('Doonga') drift across calm emerald waters with the mirror reflection of Mt. Machhapuchhre (Fishtail, 6,993m) and the Annapurna range. On a small island in the center stands the revered Tal Barahi Temple. The vibrant Lakeside strip is packed with live music cafes, artisanal bakeries, and gear shops.
fields.short_description: Nepal's second largest freshwater lake with the two-story Tal Barahi island temple.
fields.address: Pokhara, Kaski District, Gandaki Province, Nepal

fields.name: Lumbini Sacred Garden & Maya Devi Temple
fields.description: Lumbini is one of the four holiest pilgrimage destinations of Buddhism. The sacred complex features the Maya Devi Temple housing the marker stone of Buddha's exact birth spot, the sacred Pushkarini Pond where Queen Maya Devi bathed before giving birth, and the ancient Ashoka Pillar erected in 249 BC. Sprawling eastern and western monastic zones host monasteries constructed by over 25 nations.
fields.short_description: The exact historical birthplace of Siddhartha Gautama (Lord Buddha) in 623 BC.
fields.address: Lumbini Sanskritik, Rupandehi District, Lumbini Province, Nepal

fields.name: Rara Lake & National Park
fields.description: Often called the 'Queen of Lakes', Rara Lake is a pristine alpine marvel stretching 10.8 sq km at 2,990m elevation. Ringed by deep blue coniferous forests and snow-capped peaks of Chuchemara Danda, the crystal-clear water changes colors throughout the day from turquoise blue to deep indigo. Visitors enjoy horse riding around the rim, cycling, bird watching, and wilderness camping.
fields.short_description: Nepal's biggest and deepest high-altitude freshwater lake, surrounded by pine forests.
fields.address: Talcha, Mugu District, Karnali Province, Nepal

fields.name: Bandipur Heritage Hill Station
fields.description: Bandipur is a living museum of Newari architecture. Situated on a high ridge midway between Kathmandu and Pokhara, its stone-paved main bazaar is completely vehicle-free, flanked by traditional multi-story brick houses with intricate wooden balconies, open-air cafes, and bougainvillea. Hike to Thani Mai Temple on Gurungche Hill for spectacular 180-degree Himalayan sunrises.
fields.short_description: Preserved 18th-century Newari trading hilltop town with pedestrianized stone streets.
fields.address: Bandipur, Tanahun District, Gandaki Province, Nepal

fields.name: Upper Mustang & Lo Manthang
fields.description: Upper Mustang is an extraordinary high-altitude desert world of ochre and red sandstone cliffs, deep canyons, ancient sky burial caves, and Tibetan Buddhist culture. The medieval walled capital of Lo Manthang features the 15th-century King's Palace, centuries-old monasteries (Jampa, Thubchen, Chode) with rare frescoes, and the colorful Tiji Festival celebrating the victory of good over evil.
fields.short_description: The mystical 'Forbidden Kingdom' of walled royal palaces, red clay cliffs, and sky caves.
fields.address: Lo Manthang, Mustang District, Gandaki Province, Nepal

fields.caption: Near Upper Mustang & Lo Manthang — Lomanthang Rural Municipality

fields.name: Janakpurdham & Janaki Mandir
fields.description: Janakpur is the epic center of Mithila art and culture. The magnificent Janaki Mandir, also known as Nau Lakha Mandir (constructed for nine lakh rupees), is a three-storied white palace combining Mughal and Rajput architecture with 60 rooms. The town features over 70 sacred historic ponds (Dhanush Sagar, Ganga Sagar) and the vibrant Mithila Women's Art Center.
fields.short_description: Grand marble palace temple, ancient capital of Mithila Kingdom and birthplace of Goddess Sita.
fields.address: Janakpur, Dhanusha District, Madhesh Province, Nepal

fields.name: Langtang Valley & Kyanjin Gompa
fields.description: Langtang Valley is a stunning close-to-Kathmandu trek featuring dramatic glacial valleys, alpine pastures, and authentic Tamang-Tibetan Buddhist heritage. Passing through Syabrubesi, Lama Hotel, and the rebuilt Langtang Village, hikers reach Kyanjin Gompa beneath towering Langtang Lirung (7,227m). Summit Kyanjin Ri (4,773m) or Tserko Ri (4,984m) for panoramic Himalayan views.
fields.short_description: The 'Valley of Glaciers' renowned for Tamang heritage, yak cheese factories, and Kyanjin Ri.
fields.address: Rasuwa District, Bagmati Province, Nepal

fields.name: Kupinde Daha Lake
fields.description: Kupinde Daha is a pristine high-altitude lake in Salyan District, Karnali Province. The lake changes color according to season and is surrounded by lush green hills, pine trees, and the revered Barah Temple. It is a peaceful destination for boating, nature photography, and cultural pilgrimages.
fields.short_description: Scenic mountain lake in Salyan surrounded by dense pine forests and sacred Barah shrine.
fields.address: Kupinde, Salyan District, Karnali Province, Nepal

fields.name: Chhatreshwari Shakti Peeth
fields.description: Chhatreshwari Temple is a major Hindu pilgrimage site in Salyan. According to sacred scriptures, this is where Goddess Sati spine fell. Uniquely, animal sacrifices are strictly prohibited at this temple, and devotees offer flowers, belpatra, and sacred milk.
fields.short_description: Sacred Shakti Peeth temple on a hill ridge in Salyan venerated across Karnali.
fields.address: Chhatreshwari, Salyan District, Karnali Province, Nepal

fields.name: Sharada River & Luham Valley
fields.description: Luham Valley lies along the banks of the clear Sharada River in Salyan. Famous for its terraced organic ginger farms, citrus orchards, and mountain honey production, it offers scenic riverside walks and authentic rural village hospitality.
fields.short_description: Fertile agricultural valley along Sharada River famous for organic ginger and mountain honey.
fields.address: Luham, Salyan District, Karnali Province, Nepal

fields.name: Ramgram Sacred Relic Stupa
fields.description: Ramgram Stupa is a ancient brick stupa located in Parasi (Nawalparasi West). It is the only stupa containing unopened original corporeal relics (Dhatu) of Lord Buddha, protected historically by a king cobra (Naga) and wild elephants under a grand Banyan tree.
fields.short_description: UNESCO tentative list site containing the only untouched corporal relics of Lord Buddha.
fields.address: Ramgram, Parasi District, Lumbini Province, Nepal

fields.name: Triveni Dham Confluence
fields.description: Triveni Dham is a sacred river confluence in Parasi at the junction of three rivers. It is surrounded by historic temples, Valmiki Ashram from Ramayana epic, and hosting the grand Maghe Sankranti Mela festival every winter.
fields.short_description: Holy confluence of Narayani, Sona, and Tamasa rivers near Valmiki Ashram.
fields.address: Triveni, Parasi District, Lumbini Province, Nepal

fields.name: Jaleshwarnath Mahadev Temple
fields.description: Jaleshwarnath Temple in Jaleshwar, Mahottari, is a revered pilgrimage site where the main Shiva Lingam resides in an underground cave continuously submerged under natural spring water. Devotees visit during Shivaratri and Shrawan month to perform holy Jalabhishek.
fields.short_description: Historic submerged Shiva lingam temple immersed in natural underground spring water.
fields.address: Jaleshwar, Mahottari District, Madhesh Province, Nepal

fields.name: Mithila Cultural Heritage Hub
fields.description: Located in Mahottari District, Pipara Mithila Cultural Center celebrates centuries of Maithili folk art, wall paintings, clay pottery, and traditional music. Visitors can observe local women artists hand-painting Mithila artwork on natural handmade paper.
fields.short_description: Artisan center for traditional Mithila folk painting, terracotta pottery, and Maithili crafts.
fields.address: Pipara, Mahottari District, Madhesh Province, Nepal

fields.name: Gorakhnath Temple & Jaljala Ridge
fields.description: Jaljala in Rolpa is a breathtaking alpine wetland plateau at 3,100m elevation. It features the sacred Gorakhnath Temple, rhododendron forests, and unobstructed views of Mt. Dhaulagiri, Mt. Kanjirowa, and Mt. Sisne.
fields.short_description: High alpine grassland plateau at 3,100m offering sweeping vistas of Dhaulagiri and Sisne peaks.
fields.address: Jaljala, Rolpa District, Lumbini Province, Nepal

fields.name: Guerilla Trek Heritage Trail
fields.description: The Guerilla Trek passes through Thawang and the scenic heartland of Rolpa. It offers a unique cultural trek through remote Kham Magar indigenous villages, traditional slate-roofed houses, organic terraced farming, and wilderness river canyons.
fields.short_description: Historic trekking route through authentic Magar ethnic villages and pine forest gorges.
fields.address: Thawang, Rolpa District, Lumbini Province, Nepal

fields.name: Syarpu Lake & Resort
fields.description: Syarpu Lake (Syarpu Taal) is a freshwater lake located in Rukum West, Karnali Province. Spanning over 2.6 sq km, the lake is ideal for boating, fish tasting, and village homestays amidst terraced hills.
fields.short_description: Pristine mountain lake in Rukum West surrounded by terraced hills and local homestays.
fields.address: Sankh, Rukum West District, Karnali Province, Nepal
fields.nearest_police_info: District Police Office Rukum West (0.5 km)

fields.name: Sisne Himal Viewpoint
fields.description: Musikot viewpoint in Rukum West provides a dramatic vantage point facing Mt. Sisne (5,849m), the iconic virgin horn peak of Karnali. The area features pine forests, historic hill forts, and panoramic mountain sunrises.
fields.short_description: Majestic viewpoint facing the sacred unclimbed pyramid peak of Mt. Sisne (5,849m).
fields.address: Musikot, Rukum West District, Karnali Province, Nepal

fields.name: Dhanushadham Sacred Forest
fields.description: Dhanushadham is a historic pilgrimage forest 18 km from Janakpur. According to Ramayana, a piece of Shiva bow fell here when Lord Ram broke it during Sita Swayamvar. The site features a petrified bow fossil shrine surrounded by a protected forest sanctuary.
fields.short_description: Mythological forest site where Shiva divine bow fell during Sita Swayamvar in Ramayana.
fields.address: Dhanushadham, Dhanusha District, Madhesh Province, Nepal

fields.name: Badimalika Sacred Meadows
fields.description: Badimalika in Bajura is one of Sudurpashchim most sacred mountain shrines, located atop rolling alpine meadows at 4,200m elevation. Devotees undertake a 3-day scenic trek through wildflower grasslands to worship Goddess Bhagwati during Janai Purnima.
fields.short_description: High alpine grassland shrine at 4,200m offering 360-degree Himalayan vistas.
fields.address: Martadi, Bajura District, Sudurpashchim Province, Nepal

fields.name: Salhesh Fulbari Miracle Garden
fields.description: Salhesh Fulbari in Siraha is a sacred historical garden associated with the ancient folk hero King Salhesh. Uniquely, rare Haram orchid flowers bloom on a specific tree in this garden only on Chaitra 31st (Nepali New Year Eve) and fade by the end of Baisakh 1st.
fields.short_description: Historical garden famous for the miracle blooming of orchids every Nepali New Year Eve.
fields.address: Lahan, Siraha District, Madhesh Province, Nepal

fields.name: Halesi Mahadev Limestone Cave
fields.description: Halesi Mahadev Cave in Khotang is a natural limestone cave complex known as the Maratika Cave in Tibetan Buddhism and Pashupatinath of East Nepal. It is venerated as the place where Lord Shiva hid from demon Bhasmasur and Padmasambhava attained immortal life.
fields.short_description: Pashupatinath of East Nepal sacred natural cave venerated by Hindus, Buddhists, and Kirats.
fields.address: Halesi, Khotang District, Koshi Province, Nepal

fields.name: Panchase Peak & Sacred Lake
fields.description: Panchase Peak is a serene eco-trekking destination bordering Kaski, Parbat, and Syangja. Famous for its sacred Panchase Lake, ancient Shiva temple, bio-dense rhododendron forests, and panoramic views of Annapurna, Dhaulagiri, and Manaslu ranges.
fields.short_description: Panchase Peak & Sacred Lake — Kaski District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Kaski District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Pathibhara Devi Temple
fields.description: Pathibhara Devi Temple is one of Nepal's most revered Shakti Peeths situated high in eastern Taplejung district. Pilgrims flock here to worship Goddess Pathibhara while enjoying sweeping views of Mount Kanchenjunga.
fields.short_description: Pathibhara Devi Temple — Taplejung District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Taplejung District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Barahachhetra Temple Sanctuary
fields.description: Barahachhetra is an ancient pilgrimage site situated at the confluence of the Koka and Saptakoshi rivers in Sunsari. It is dedicated to Lord Vishnu's Varaha (boar) avatar and mentioned in classical Puranas.
fields.short_description: Barahachhetra Temple Sanctuary — Sunsari District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Sunsari District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal
fields.nearest_hospital_info: B.P. Koirala Institute Of Health Sciences (12.3 km)

fields.name: Kalinchowk Bhagwati Temple
fields.description: Kalinchowk Bhagwati Temple sits perched on a high cliff ridge in Dolakha district. Known for winter snow, cable car access from Kuri village, and stunning panoramas of Mount Gaurishankar and Langtang range.
fields.short_description: Kalinchowk Bhagwati Temple — Dolakha District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Dolakha District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Namobuddha Thrangu Tashi Yangtse Monastery
fields.description: Namobuddha is one of Nepal's four major Buddhist holy pilgrimage sites. Located atop a lush ridge in Kavre, it marks the sacred spot where the Bodhisattva fed his body to a starving tigress and her cubs.
fields.short_description: Namobuddha Thrangu Tashi Yangtse Monastery — Kavrepalanchok District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Kavrepalanchok District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Chandragiri Hill & Bhaleshwor Temple
fields.description: Chandragiri Hill lies on the south-west rim of Kathmandu Valley. Accessible by scenic cable car, it features the historic Bhaleshwor Mahadev Temple and panoramic views stretching from Mount Everest to Annapurna.
fields.short_description: Chandragiri Hill & Bhaleshwor Temple — Kathmandu District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Kathmandu District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal
fields.nearest_hospital_info: Armed Police Force Hospital Emergency (3.7 km)

fields.name: Sailung Peak & Rolling Mounds
fields.description: Sailung Peak, meaning 'Hundred Mounds', features unique grassy hillocks, ancient Buddhist stupas, and sacred Hindu caves along the Ramechhap-Dolakha border. Offers 360-degree views of Everest and Langtang mountains.
fields.short_description: Sailung Peak & Rolling Mounds — Ramechhap District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Ramechhap District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Gosainkunda Sacred Alpine Lakes
fields.description: Gosainkunda is an alpine glacier lake complex inside Langtang National Park. Revered by Hindus and Buddhists as the abode of Lord Shiva, it attracts thousands of pilgrims during Janai Purnima festival.
fields.short_description: Gosainkunda Sacred Alpine Lakes — Rasuwa District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Rasuwa District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Devghat Dham River Confluence
fields.description: Devghat Dham is a sacred holy river confluence where the Trishuli and Kali Gandaki rivers meet. It features ancient ashrams, Sanskrit pathshalas, and hosts massive Makar Sankranti bathing fairs.
fields.short_description: Devghat Dham River Confluence — Chitwan District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Chitwan District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal
fields.nearest_hospital_info: B.P. Koirala Memorial Cancer Hospital (3.6 km)

fields.name: Bandipur Newari Hilltop Heritage
fields.description: Bandipur is a living museum of traditional Newari architecture perched high above the Marsyangdi river valley. Features vehicle-free cobblestone streets, wooden carvings, Siddha Cave, and mountain views.
fields.short_description: Bandipur Newari Hilltop Heritage — Tanahun District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Tanahun District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Gorkha Durbar Fortress Palace
fields.description: Gorkha Durbar is a historic 16th-century palace, fortress, and temple complex overlooking the Gorkha valley. The birthplace of King Prithvi Narayan Shah, founder of unified modern Nepal.
fields.short_description: Gorkha Durbar Fortress Palace — Gorkha District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Gorkha District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Galeshwor Dham Monolithic Shiva Shrine
fields.description: Galeshwor Dham is a sacred Shiva temple built atop a single continuous 9-ropani solid rock along the Kali Gandaki river. Serves as the gateway to the Annapurna Circuit and Mustang pilgrimages.
fields.short_description: Galeshwor Dham Monolithic Shiva Shrine — Myagdi District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Myagdi District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Shey Phoksundo Turquoise Alpine Lake
fields.description: Shey Phoksundo Lake is an alpine freshwater lake in Shey Phoksundo National Park. Famous for its striking turquoise waters, Ringmo Bon village, ancient monasteries, and zero aquatic life.
fields.short_description: Shey Phoksundo Turquoise Alpine Lake — Dolpa District, Karnali Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Dolpa District, Karnali Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Rara Lake National Park Sanctuary
fields.description: Rara Lake is the largest freshwater lake in Nepal, often called the 'Queen of Lakes'. Nestled inside Rara National Park, it features pristine crystal waters surrounded by pine forests and snow peaks.
fields.short_description: Rara Lake National Park Sanctuary — Mugu District, Karnali Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Mugu District, Karnali Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Khaptad High Meadows & Ashram
fields.description: Khaptad National Park is a high-altitude plateau spanning Bajhang, Bajura, Doti, and Achham. Features 22 rolling green moorlands ('Patan'), Khaptad Baba's spiritual ashram, and diverse medicinal flora.
fields.short_description: Khaptad High Meadows & Ashram — Bajhang District, Sudurpashchim Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Bajhang District, Sudurpashchim Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Champa Devi Sanctuary Peak
fields.description: Champa Devi Peak is a popular day hike on the south rim of Kathmandu Valley above Pharping. Offers pine trail ridge walks, Champa Devi Goddess Shrine, and views of Langtang and Ganesh Himal.
fields.short_description: Champa Devi Sanctuary Peak — Kathmandu District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Kathmandu District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Tinjure Milke Jaljale Rhododendron Forest
fields.description: TMJ (Tinjure-Milke-Jaljale) ridge is widely celebrated as the 'Rhododendron Capital of Nepal'. Home to 28 out of 32 native Nepalese rhododendron species in full bloom during spring.
fields.short_description: Tinjure Milke Jaljale Rhododendron Forest — Tehrathum District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Tehrathum District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Bhedetar Hillstation Viewpoint
fields.description: Bhedetar is a famous cool hillstation village situated on the ridge connecting Sunsari and Dhankuta. Features Charles Tower, Namaste Falls, and sweeping views of the Tamor river valley.
fields.short_description: Bhedetar Hillstation Viewpoint — Sunsari District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Sunsari District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal
fields.nearest_hospital_info: B.P. Koirala Institute Of Health Sciences (6.8 km)

fields.name: Janaki Mandir Palace Temple Complex
fields.description: Janaki Mandir is a magnificent 19th-century Mughal-Koiri marble palace temple in Janakpurdham dedicated to Goddess Sita. Major pilgrimage destination for Vivaha Panchami and Ram Navami.
fields.short_description: Janaki Mandir Palace Temple Complex — Dhanusha District, Madhesh Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Dhanusha District, Madhesh Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Swargadwari Sacred Hilltop Temple
fields.description: Swargadwari ('Door to Heaven') is a hilltop pilgrimage complex in Pyuthan founded by Swami Hansananda. Features unbroken Yajna sacrificial fires, Vedic pathshalas, and thousands of sacred cows.
fields.short_description: Swargadwari Sacred Hilltop Temple — Pyuthan District, Lumbini Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Pyuthan District, Lumbini Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Muktinath Temple & Eternal Flame
fields.description: Muktinath is a sacred Vishnu temple revered by both Hindus and Buddhists as Chumig Gyatsa ('Hundred Waters'). Located at the foot of Thorong La pass in Mustang, it features 108 bull-headed holy water spouts and an eternal natural gas flame.
fields.short_description: Muktinath Temple & Eternal Flame — Mustang District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Mustang District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Tilicho Glacier Lake Sanctuary
fields.description: Tilicho Lake is one of the highest alpine lakes in the world, sitting beneath the formidable north face of Tilicho Peak in Manang. A highlight of the Annapurna Circuit trek with vivid deep blue waters and glacial ice walls.
fields.short_description: Tilicho Glacier Lake Sanctuary — Manang District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Manang District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Simikot Valley & Kailash Gateway
fields.description: Simikot is the remote district headquarters of Humla in far-western Nepal. Accessible primarily by mountain flights, it serves as the primary gateway for pilgrimage treks along the Karnali river route to Mount Kailash and Lake Manasarovar.
fields.short_description: Simikot Valley & Kailash Gateway — Humla District, Karnali Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Humla District, Karnali Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Chandannath Temple & Red Paddy Hub
fields.description: Chandannath Temple is a historic pagoda shrine in Jumla Bazaar dedicated to Lord Dattatreya. Jumla valley is world-famous for cultivating unique high-altitude red rice (Marshi Dhan) and organic apples.
fields.short_description: Chandannath Temple & Red Paddy Hub — Jumla District, Karnali Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Jumla District, Karnali Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Mai Pokhari Ramsar Wetland Lake
fields.description: Mai Pokhari is a holy Ramsar wetland lake in Ilam encircled by sacred oak and rhododendron forests. Revered as the home of Goddess Maipokhari, it features nine lake corners and endemic salamander species.
fields.short_description: Mai Pokhari Ramsar Wetland Lake — Ilam District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Ilam District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Kagbeni Medieval Mustang Fortress
fields.description: Kagbeni is a 500-year-old mud-brick fortress village standing at the confluence of Mustang Khola and Jhong River. Serves as the gateway to restricted Upper Mustang with ancient chortens and monasteries.
fields.short_description: Kagbeni Medieval Mustang Fortress — Mustang District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Mustang District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Triveni Dham & Valmiki Ashram
fields.description: Triveni Dham is a sacred river confluence of Narayani, Sona, and Tamasa rivers near Chitwan National Park border. Nearby Valmiki Ashram is the legendary hermitage where Sage Valmiki composed the Ramayana.
fields.short_description: Triveni Dham & Valmiki Ashram — Nawalparasi West District, Lumbini Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Nawalparasi West District, Lumbini Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Resunga Sacred Hillstation & Ashram
fields.description: Resunga Hill is a sacred mountain forest overlooking Tamghas bazaar in Gulmi. Features Yajna Kund, ancient hermitages of Rishis, panoramic views of Dhaulagiri and Annapurna, and cool pine air.
fields.short_description: Resunga Sacred Hillstation & Ashram — Gulmi District, Lumbini Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Gulmi District, Lumbini Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Supadeurali Cliffside Temple Pass
fields.description: Supadeurali Temple is a revered Bhagwati shrine set between dramatic rock cliffs along the Gorusinghe-Sandhikharka highway in Arghakhanchi. Famous for fulfilling vows made by travelers and soldiers.
fields.short_description: Supadeurali Cliffside Temple Pass — Arghakhanchi District, Lumbini Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Arghakhanchi District, Lumbini Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Rani Mahal Riverfront Palace
fields.description: Rani Mahal, dubbed the 'Taj Mahal of Nepal', is a 19th-century neoclassical palace built on a massive rock along the Kali Gandaki river by General Khadga Shamsher in memory of his beloved wife Tej Kumari.
fields.short_description: Rani Mahal Riverfront Palace — Palpa District, Lumbini Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Palpa District, Lumbini Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Ghalegaun Gurung Cultural Village
fields.description: Ghalegaun is an award-winning model eco-homestay village in Lamjung inhabited by the indigenous Gurung community. Offers traditional cultural dances, wild honey hunting views, and vistas of Annapurna and Manaslu.
fields.short_description: Ghalegaun Gurung Cultural Village — Lamjung District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Lamjung District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Sindhuligadhi Historic Hill Fort
fields.description: Sindhuligadhi is a historic hilltop fort where the Gorkhali army led by Kaji Kalu Pande defeated the British East India Company forces in 1767. Features a military war museum and panoramic valley views.
fields.short_description: Sindhuligadhi Historic Hill Fort — Sindhuli District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Sindhuli District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Kankrebihar Monolithic Buddhist Shrine
fields.description: Kankrebihar is a 12th-century stone Buddhist temple structure nestled inside a protected dense forest near Birendranagar in Surkhet valley. Often referred to as the 'Sanchi of Nepal' for its ancient stone carvings.
fields.short_description: Kankrebihar Monolithic Buddhist Shrine — Surkhet District, Karnali Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Surkhet District, Karnali Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Lomanthang Ancient Walled City
fields.description: Lomanthang is the walled historic capital of the former Kingdom of Lo in Upper Mustang. Features 15th-century royal palace, Jampa Lakhang, Thubchen Gompa, sky caves, and rich Tibetan Bon and Buddhist traditions.
fields.short_description: Lomanthang Ancient Walled City — Mustang District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Mustang District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Panchthar Chhintang Devi Shrine
fields.description: Chhintang Devi Temple is a hilltop pilgrimage shrine in Panchthar surrounded by cardamom farms, orange orchards, and pine ridges. Offers views of the Tamor river valley and Kanchenjunga.
fields.short_description: Panchthar Chhintang Devi Shrine — Panchthar District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Panchthar District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Bhojpur Taksar Bronze Craft Hub
fields.description: Taksar in Bhojpur is a historic Newari artisan settlement famous across Nepal for handcrafting traditional bronze Karuwa spouts, brass kitchenware, and world-renowned Gorkha Khukuri blades.
fields.short_description: Bhojpur Taksar Bronze Craft Hub — Bhojpur District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Bhojpur District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Kakani Hillstation & Strawberry Ridge
fields.description: Kakani is a scenic hillstation on the northern rim of Kathmandu Valley in Nuwakot. Renowned for strawberry farming, rainbow trout hatcheries, Thai Airways memorial park, and Langtang mountain vistas.
fields.short_description: Kakani Hillstation & Strawberry Ridge — Nuwakot District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Nuwakot District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Syarpu Lake Eco Retreat
fields.description: Syarpu Lake is a serene freshwater natural lake in Rukum West. Encircled by green pine hills and traditional villages, it offers boating, local organic fish delicacies, and quiet natural relaxation.
fields.short_description: Syarpu Lake Eco Retreat — Rukum West District, Karnali Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Rukum West District, Karnali Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Pashupatinath Sacred Hindu Sanctuary
fields.description: Pashupatinath Temple is a sacred UNESCO World Heritage Hindu temple complex dedicated to Lord Shiva situated along the holy Bagmati River in Kathmandu. Features pagoda architecture, silver-plated doors, holy sadhus, and evening Bagmati Aarati ceremonies.
fields.short_description: Pashupatinath Sacred Hindu Sanctuary — Kathmandu District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Kathmandu District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Boudhanath Stupa & Tibetan Monasteries
fields.description: Boudhanath is one of the largest spherical stupas in Nepal and a UNESCO World Heritage site. Surrounded by 50+ Tibetan monasteries, prayer wheels, rooftop cafes, and butter lamps, it serves as the focal point of Tibetan Buddhism in Kathmandu.
fields.short_description: Boudhanath Stupa & Tibetan Monasteries — Kathmandu District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Kathmandu District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal
fields.nearest_hotel_info: Boudha Stupa View Guest House (0.0 km)

fields.name: Pokhara Lakeside & Tal Barahi Island Temple
fields.description: Pokhara Lakeside stretches along the tranquil shores of Phewa Lake with reflections of Mount Machhapuchhre (Fishtail). Features wooden rowboats, Tal Barahi island pagoda temple, vibrant cafes, and lakeside promenades.
fields.short_description: Pokhara Lakeside & Tal Barahi Island Temple — Kaski District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Kaski District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Sarangkot Paragliding & Sunrise Hillstation
fields.description: Sarangkot is Pokhara's premier hilltop viewpoint situated at 1,600m. Celebrated for golden sunrise over Dhaulagiri, Annapurna Massif, and Machhapuchhre, as well as world-class tandem paragliding takeoffs.
fields.short_description: Sarangkot Paragliding & Sunrise Hillstation — Kaski District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Kaski District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Devi's Fall & Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave
fields.description: Devi's Fall (Patale Chhango) is an unusual underground waterfall where Pardi Khola stream disappears into a subterranean gorge. Across the street lies Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave with a natural rock Shiva lingam inside.
fields.short_description: Devi's Fall & Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave — Kaski District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Kaski District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Patan Durbar Square & Golden Temple
fields.description: Patan Durbar Square in Lalitpur is a masterpiece of Malla Newari architecture. Home to the 21-pinnacle stone Krishna Mandir, Golden Temple (Hiranya Varna Mahavihar), Patan Museum, and bronze metal craft workshops.
fields.short_description: Patan Durbar Square & Golden Temple — Lalitpur District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Lalitpur District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal
fields.nearest_police_info: Police Station Patan Durbar Square (0.0 km)

fields.name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square & Nyatapola Temple
fields.description: Bhaktapur Durbar Square is a open-air living museum of ancient Newari culture. Highlights include the 55-Window Palace, Golden Gate, 5-tiered Nyatapola Temple, Pottery Square, and authentic Juju Dhau curd.
fields.short_description: Bhaktapur Durbar Square & Nyatapola Temple — Bhaktapur District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Bhaktapur District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Chitwan Sauraha Jungle Safari & Elephant Reserve
fields.description: Chitwan National Park in Sauraha is Nepal's premier wildlife safari destination and UNESCO World Heritage sanctuary. Home to the endangered Greater One-Horned Rhinoceros, Royal Bengal Tiger, Gharial crocodile, and Tharu cultural dances.
fields.short_description: Chitwan Sauraha Jungle Safari & Elephant Reserve — Chitwan District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Chitwan District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Bardiya Tiger Reserve & Wilderness Safari
fields.description: Bardiya National Park in Thakurdwara is Nepal's largest undisturbed terai wilderness. Celebrated for high tiger sighting probabilities, wild Asian elephants, swamp deer, and Gangetic river dolphins on the Karnali River.
fields.short_description: Bardiya Tiger Reserve & Wilderness Safari — Bardiya District, Lumbini Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Bardiya District, Lumbini Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Ghandruk Gurung Stone Heritage Village
fields.description: Ghandruk is a picturesque stone-roofed Gurung mountain village in the Annapurna Conservation Area. Features traditional slate-paved alleyways, Gurung cultural museum, organic apple orchards, and face-to-face views of Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre.
fields.short_description: Ghandruk Gurung Stone Heritage Village — Kaski District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Kaski District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Poon Hill Rhododendron Sunrise Viewpoint
fields.description: Poon Hill near Ghorepani is one of Nepal's most famous trekking viewpoints (3,210m). Offers breathtaking 360-degree views of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges framed by blooming spring rhododendron forests.
fields.short_description: Poon Hill Rhododendron Sunrise Viewpoint — Myagdi District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Myagdi District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Gokyo Turquoise Lakes & Gokyo Ri Peak
fields.description: Gokyo Lakes are six high-altitude glacial lakes in Sagarmatha National Park. Nearby Gokyo Ri peak (5,357m) offers vistas of four 8,000m giant peaks: Mount Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, and Cho Oyu.
fields.short_description: Gokyo Turquoise Lakes & Gokyo Ri Peak — Solukhumbu District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Solukhumbu District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Manakamana Wish-Fulfilling Temple Cable Car
fields.description: Manakamana Temple is a revered pilgrimage shrine dedicated to Goddess Bhagwati, believed to fulfill the wishes of her devotees. Accessible via Nepal's first cable car system starting from Kurintar along the Trishuli River.
fields.short_description: Manakamana Wish-Fulfilling Temple Cable Car — Gorkha District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Gorkha District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Kanyam Tea Estate & Horse Riding Ridge
fields.description: Kanyam is Nepal's most famous tea garden destination situated along the Mechi Highway in Ilam. Features manicured green tea hills, traditional horse riding trails, tea tasting cottage stalls, and cool mountain fog.
fields.short_description: Kanyam Tea Estate & Horse Riding Ridge — Ilam District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Ilam District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Shree Antu Danda Sunrise Viewpoint
fields.description: Shree Antu Danda in eastern Ilam is famous for receiving the very first rays of sunrise in Nepal. Offers vistas over Mount Kanchenjunga, Mirik tea hills, and Antu Pokhari lake.
fields.short_description: Shree Antu Danda Sunrise Viewpoint — Ilam District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Ilam District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Koshi Tappu Wildlife Ramsar Reserve
fields.description: Koshi Tappu Wildlife Reserve is a Ramsar wetland on the floodplains of the Sapta Koshi River spanning Sunsari, Saptari, and Udayapur. Famous as the last refuge of wild water buffaloes (Arna) and over 500 migratory bird species.
fields.short_description: Koshi Tappu Wildlife Ramsar Reserve — Sunsari District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Sunsari District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Manang Rain-Shadow Valley & Braga Monastery
fields.description: Manang Valley sits in the rain shadow of the Annapurna range along the Marsyangdi River. Features ancient cliffside Braga Monastery (Brakha), Chame hot springs, Gangapurna Glacier Lake, and Tibetan Buddhist culture.
fields.short_description: Manang Rain-Shadow Valley & Braga Monastery — Manang District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Manang District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Gorkha Museum & Tallo Durbar Palace
fields.description: Gorkha Museum is housed inside the historic 1835 Newari-style Tallo Durbar Palace in Gorkha Bazaar. Displays royal weaponry, Gorkhali military armor, ancient coins, and historical unification archives.
fields.short_description: Gorkha Museum & Tallo Durbar Palace — Gorkha District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal.
fields.address: Gorkha District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Lumbini Crane Sanctuary & Wetland Reserve
fields.description: The Lumbini Crane Sanctuary encompasses over 250 hectares of protected wetlands surrounding the International Monastic Zone. It provides a peaceful habitat for Sarus Cranes, blue bulls (nilgai), wild boars, and over 200 species of migratory birds.
fields.short_description: Protected wetland haven for rare Sarus Cranes adjacent to the Sacred Garden of Lumbini.
fields.address: Lumbini, Rupandehi District, Lumbini Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Kuri Village & Kalinchowk Bhagwati Altitude Shrine
fields.description: Kuri Village is a scenic high-altitude valley famous for winter snow, colorful stone lodges, and the Kalinchowk Bhagwati Shrine perched dramatically atop a cliff reachable by cable car or scenic ridge walk.
fields.short_description: Snow-capped alpine ridge and famous cable-car shrine with 360-degree Himalayan views.
fields.address: Kuri, Dolakha District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Bandipur Silktrail & Tudikhel Viewpoint
fields.description: Bandipur is a preserved hill settlement overlooking the Marshyangdi River valley. Features vehicle-free paved bazaars, traditional wooden balconies, cozy guesthouses, and panoramic vistas stretching from Dhaulagiri to Langtang.
fields.short_description: Living museum of 18th-century Newari architecture with vehicle-free cobbled streets.
fields.address: Bandipur, Tanahun District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Kakani Rhododendron & Strawberry Valley
fields.description: Located just 29 km northwest of Kathmandu, Kakani offers crisp mountain air, dense pine forests, organic strawberry and trout farms, and the International Mountaineers Memorial Park.
fields.short_description: Tranquil mountain ridge near Kathmandu renowned for organic strawberry farms and Ganesh Himal vistas.
fields.address: Kakani, Nuwakot District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Daman Himalayan Panorama Tower
fields.description: Perched on the Tribhuvan Highway, Daman features a public view tower with high-powered telescopes providing views of 8 of the world's 10 highest peaks on clear days.
fields.short_description: Unmatched view of the longest continuous stretch of the Himalayas from Dhaulagiri to Everest.
fields.address: Daman, Makwanpur District, Bagmati Province Province, Nepal
fields.nearest_hospital_info: Armed Police Force Hospital Emergency (18.4 km)

fields.name: Besisahar Marshyangdi Gateway
fields.description: Besisahar lies along the roaring Marshyangdi River. It serves as the administrative capital of Lamjung district and the vibrant logistics gateway for trekkers, jeep safaris, and mountain bikers heading towards Manang and Thorong La Pass.
fields.short_description: The official starting hub for the world-famous Annapurna Circuit Trek.
fields.address: Besisahar, Lamjung District, Gandaki Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Namche Bazaar Sherpa Cultural Capital
fields.description: Namche Bazaar features colorful horseshoe-shaped stone terraces tucked into a steep mountain bowl. Home to Tibetan trading markets, German bakeries, mountaineering museums, and breathtaking views of Thamserku and Everest.
fields.short_description: Amphitheater-shaped Sherpa town and bustling heart of Khumbu Everest region.
fields.address: Namche Bazaar, Solukhumbu District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Tengboche Buddhist Monastery
fields.description: Positioned atop a high ridge at the confluence of the Dudh Koshi and Imja Khola rivers, Tengboche Monastery offers spiritual solace and iconic views of Mount Everest, Lhotse, and Ama Dablam.
fields.short_description: The largest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Khumbu set against Ama Dablam.
fields.address: Tengboche, Solukhumbu District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Dingboche Himalayan Highland Settlement
fields.description: Dingboche is a summer farming settlement in the Imja Valley. It is framed by dramatic stone walls protecting barley and potato crops from cold mountain winds, with views of Island Peak and Lhotse.
fields.short_description: Key acclimatization village surrounded by stone-walled barley fields and towering peaks.
fields.address: Dingboche, Solukhumbu District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Lukla Tenzing-Hillary Airport Valley
fields.description: Lukla is an energetic mountain town boasting twin-otter aircraft landings, trekking equipment shops, cozy lodges, and the Gateway Arch into Sagarmatha National Park.
fields.short_description: Dramatic mountain airstrip and starting point for all Everest region expeditions.
fields.address: Lukla, Solukhumbu District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Barun Valley Wilderness Sanctuary
fields.description: Part of Makalu Barun National Park, the Barun Valley is a biodiversity hotspot dominated by dramatic granite cliffs, cascading waterfalls, rhododendron forests, and views of Mount Makalu.
fields.short_description: Pristine glacial valley harboring rare snow leopards, red pandas, and 3,000 flowering plant species.
fields.address: Makalu Barun, Sankhuwasabha District, Koshi Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Api Nampa Conservation Peak Reserve
fields.description: Located in the far-western corner of Nepal, Api Nampa Conservation Area boasts untouched sub-tropical forests, glaciers, medicinal herbs (Yarsagumba), and Mount Api (7,132m).
fields.short_description: Remote mountain sanctuary featuring Mount Api, alpine lakes, and Byansi indigenous heritage.
fields.address: Darchula, Darchula District, Sudurpashchim Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Badimalika Sacred Alpine Plateau
fields.description: Badimalika is a majestic high-altitude meadow plateau featuring panoramic views, wild herbs, and a shrine celebrating Goddess Bhagwati. Accessible via scenic multi-day ridge treks.
fields.short_description: Endless rolling green meadows and hilltop Devi temple overlooking the Far-Western Himalayas.
fields.address: Martadi, Bajura District, Sudurpashchim Province Province, Nepal

fields.name: Gaddachowki Western Border Gateway
fields.description: Gaddachowki connects Nepal to Uttarakhand, India across the Mahakali River and Banbasa Barrage. It is a lively gateway to Mahendranagar and the Shuklaphanta swamp deer grassland reserves.
fields.short_description: Nepal's westernmost international overland border crossing near Shuklaphanta National Park.
fields.address: Bhimdatta, Kanchanpur District, Sudurpashchim Province Province, Nepal
